map.中国大陆/港码以戒指内圈周长(mm)为号(如12号=周长52mm)；美码以直径为: China mainland / Hong Kong sizes are numbered by inner circumference (mm) (e.g. size 12 = 52 mm circumference); US sizes are based on diameter; Japan sizes are circumference minus 38; EU sizes are numbered by circumference.
map.用软尺量指围算直径，对照圈号。: Measure finger circumference with a soft tape to get the diameter and match the ring number.

map.直径 = 周长 ÷ π = 55 ÷ 3.14159 ≈ 17.5mm。港码约: Diameter = circumference ÷ π = 55 ÷ 3.14159 ≈ 17.5 mm. Hong Kong size is about 14 (inner 17.5 mm); EU is often marked 55.
map.下午量更准: Measure in the afternoon for accuracy
map.手指早晚/冷热胀缩约 ±0.5 号；建议下午温暖时量，取略紧不脱落为准，宽版戒需: Fingers swell/shrink about ±0.5 size between morning/evening and with heat/cold; measure in the warm afternoon, taking a slightly snug fit that does not slip off as the standard, and add half a size for wide bands.
map.港码和欧码怎么对？: How do Hong Kong and EU sizes correspond?
map.欧码多直接标内圈周长(mm，如 55)；港码=内圈直径(mm)−? 约 14 号: EU sizes often mark the inner circumference directly (mm, e.g. 55); Hong Kong size roughly equals the inner diameter (mm) — about size 14 corresponds to 17.5 mm. Brands vary, so use the measured inner diameter.
map.量不出内径怎么办？: What if I cannot measure the inner diameter?
map.用细线绕手指一圈量周长最稳：剪一条无弹性细线绕指根一周，在重叠处做记号后拉直量长: Measuring circumference by wrapping a string around the finger is most reliable: cut a non-elastic string, wrap it around the finger base for one turn, mark the overlap, straighten and measure the length (mm) — that is the circumference; inner diameter = circumference ÷ π. Measure in the evening when the finger is thickest, and measure the finger base not the knuckle; if the knuckle is clearly thicker than the base, take the midpoint of the two values to avoid a ring that is too tight or slips off.
